note: War rules. Combat, supply and peace values are gameplay estimates. nuclear_states_2000 lists the states that had openly tested nuclear weapons by 2000; Israel, which has never acknowledged an arsenal, is not listed. Combat also weighs flanking (attacks from several provinces), supply (divisions over a province's supply fight worse) and terrain and entrenchment. river_crossing_penalty waits for river data in the map.
